name: REL7-1-the-old-notes-kept
note: The old notes would stand under the new ones, "Fixes and improvements." among them.

name: REL7-2-the-list-dropped
note: GitHub's list of merged changes would be lost from the release.

name: REL7-3-crlf-read-as-is
old:
const text = String(current ?? '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
  const cut = text.search(GENERATED_LIST_RE);
new:
const text = String(current ?? '');
  const cut = text.search(GENERATED_LIST_RE);
note: A body GitHub hands back with CRLF would keep its carriage returns in the list.

name: REL7-4-a-cut-of-its-own
old: export const GENERATED_LIST_RE = /^(##\s*What['’]s Changed\b|\*\*Full Changelog\*\*|##\s*New Contributors\b)/m;
note: The release's cut and the launcher's would drift apart.

name: REL7-5-any-checkout-will-do
old: if (head !== tagged) throw new Error(`HEAD is ${head}, not ${a} (${tagged})`);
note: A checkout past the tag would read pull requests the release never brought.

name: REL7-6-a-failed-read-writes-anyway
old:
console.error(`the notes could not be read - the release is left as it is: ${String(e?.stderr || e?.message || e).trim()}`);
      return 1;
new:
console.error(`the notes could not be read - the release is left as it is: ${String(e?.stderr || e?.message || e).trim()}`);
      notes = [];
note: GitHub down: the release's notes would be written over with "Fixes and improvements.".

name: REL7-7-the-tag-unchecked
note: A tag carrying quotes or a newline would reach the checkout and the API.

name: REL7-8-the-branch-not-the-tag
note: The notes would be read up to main's head, not the release's own commit.

name: REL7-9-a-schedule-of-its-own
note: The workflow would rewrite releases on its own.

if (head !== tagged) throw new Error(`HEAD is ${head}, not ${a} (${tagged})`);
      notes = pullRequestNotesSince(previousReleaseTag(a));
new:
